'''Yuka Terasaki''' (Japanese: '''寺崎裕香''' ''Terasaki Yuka'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}} and {{aniseries|HZ}}.

==Biography==
Terasaki was born in {{wp|Kumamoto Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}} on August 4, 1983, and became a voice actress and singer as an adult. Terasaki began to provide voices for the {{pkmn|animated series}} near the end of {{aniseries|BW}}. She has since provided the voices of a few [[Character of the day|characters of the day]]. During {{aniseries|XY}}, she voiced [[Korrina]], [[Ash's Fletchinder]], [[Ash's Noibat]], and [[Clemont's Luxio]]. Her most prominent role was in {{aniseries|HZ}}, where she voiced a main character, [[Roy]], for the first time. Terasaki is currently affiliated with Ogipro the Next.
